app.name: Videcook
app.tagline: The easy way to download videos
help.title: How to Use
help.video_step_1: Copy the video link you want to download.
help.video_step_2: Paste the video link into Videcook's "Download" page.
help.video_step_4: Choose the quality level (Best quality, 1080p, 720p, or 480p).
help.video_step_5: If the video is members-only, enable "Members-Only Video" and select your cookies.txt file.
help.video_step_6: Choose the folder where the video will be saved.
help.video_step_7: Click "Download" and wait for the process to complete.
help.video_warning: Your cookie file is never stored. The cookie path is cleared after download completes or is cancelled.
help.audio_step_1: Copy the video link you want to download.
help.audio_step_2: Paste the video link into Videcook's "Download" page.
help.audio_step_4: Choose the audio format (MP3, M4A, Opus, AAC, FLAC, or WAV).
help.audio_step_5: Optionally check "Embed Thumbnail + Metadata" to include cover art.
help.audio_step_6: Choose the folder where the file will be saved.
help.audio_step_7: Click "Download" and wait for the process to complete.
help.audio_warning: Only the audio is extracted from the video. No video file is downloaded, only an audio file is created.
help.subtitle_step_1: Create a Groq account and get your free API key (console.groq.com).
help.subtitle_step_2: Go to Settings, enter your Groq API key, and click "Save Key".
help.subtitle_step_3: Open the "Subtitles" page from the sidebar.
help.subtitle_step_5: Choose where to save the .srt file.
help.subtitle_step_7: Videcook splits the audio into chunks, sends them to Groq Whisper, and creates an English .srt file.
help.subtitle_warning: Subtitle generation requires an internet connection. It runs within Groq's free quota. Each user uses their own API key.

log.select_cookie_first: Please select a cookie file first.
log.select_url_first: Please enter a video URL first.

error.binaries_missing: Required helper binaries not found. yt-dlp.exe and ffmpeg.exe must exist in: "{bin_dir}".
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred during download.
error.http_403: Access denied (403). The video may be private, region-blocked, or members-only. If it's a members-only video, enable the toggle above and provide a valid cookies.txt.
error.http_404: Video not found (404). The URL may be incorrect or the video was deleted.
error.http_429: Too many requests (429). YouTube is rate-limiting. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.video_unavailable: This video is not available. It may have been removed, made private, or is blocked in your region.
error.video_private: This video is private. You need access permissions to download it.
error.members_only: This is a members-only video. Enable "Members-Only Video" toggle and provide a valid cookies.txt file.
error.network: Network error. Unable to reach the server. Check your internet connection.
error.extract_failed: Could not process this video. The site may have changed its structure. Try updating yt-dlp.
error.format_unavailable: The selected quality is not available for this video. Try a different quality option.
error.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg is required but not found. Use the Setup page to install it.
error.login_required: This video requires login. Enable "Members-Only Video" toggle and provide cookies.
error.ssl: SSL certificate error. Your system time may be incorrect, or a proxy is interfering.
error.invalid_cookie: The cookie file is invalid or expired. Try exporting cookies again from your browser.
error.geo_restricted: This video is not available in your country. You may need a VPN or proxy.
error.rate_limit: YouTube is rate-limiting your requests. Try adding --sleep-interval 3 in Advanced Settings.
error.no_internet: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
error.cookie_expired: The cookie file appears to be expired. Export fresh cookies from your browser and try again.
